story_title: Hikvision IP camera improper authentication backdoor CVE-2017-7921 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Internal development probe (not a holdout case): the contract-complete record demonstration candidate. The official Hikvision advisory (server-rendered, allowlisted path) lists seven affected camera model series, per-model affected firmware ranges with build numbers, and per-model resolved firmware versions; the probe observes whether the revision-6 union matcher plus prompt v3 yields per-model claims rows with matcher-supported affected and fixed ranges and evidence-backed models. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Hikvision | Multiple Products | added 2026-03-05).
